services.title: Thailand University Admissions Planning
services.description: Not sure where to begin, or working with a limited tutoring budget? This service is designed to turn uncertainty into a clear, actionable roadmap — helping Dek70, Dek71, and Dek72 students plan their path into their dream faculty with direction, without overspending on unnecessarily expensive prep courses.
features: A systematic assessment of your strengths and weaknesses before setting a goal that truly fits you
We map out your study approach and initial portfolio direction together, tailored to your faculty and goals
Guidance on a cost-effective self-study plan that gets you admitted even on a limited budget — no pricey courses required

Guided by someone who has actually sat the exams and scored in the Top 1% (99th Percentile) in A-Level Mathematics 1 and Physics — so you get both the content and the preparation strategy from real experience
deliverables: A full PDF roadmap, compiled from what we discuss in the session and sent to you afterward
A personalized study schedule with initial portfolio guidance and how to handle common situations
services.price: 500 THB per 30–60 minute consultation, including the PDF roadmap compiled and delivered after the session. Pay only for what you genuinely need — far better value than investing tens of thousands in a course that may not suit you.
